title: Olist · Pilotage
description: Scénarios du runner : statut, volumétrie, qualité, DuckDB, OpenLineage, infrastructure et alertes.

targets.rawSql:
select count(*) filter (where status = 'success')               as "Succès",
       count(*) filter (where status = 'failed')                as "Échecs",
       count(*) filter (where status in ('queued', 'running'))  as "En cours"
from obs.pipeline_runs where $__timeFilter(requested_at)

panels.title: Quarantaine (dernier build)
panels.description: Part des articles écartés par dbt (prix nul, frais négatifs, dates incohérentes). Seuil : 5 %.

targets.rawSql:
select value as "Quarantaine" from obs.run_metrics
where step = 'quality' and metric = 'quarantine_pct' order by recorded_at desc limit 1

panels.title: Rejets du contrat
panels.description: Lignes refusées par l'ingestion (format, références) sur la période.

targets.rawSql:
select coalesce(sum(m.value), 0) as "Rejets" from obs.run_metrics m join obs.pipeline_runs p using (run_id)
where m.step = 'load_raw' and m.metric = 'rows_rejected' and $__timeFilter(p.requested_at)

select coalesce(sum(m.value), 0) as "Insérées" from obs.run_metrics m join obs.pipeline_runs p using (run_id)
where m.step = 'load_raw' and m.metric = 'rows_inserted' and $__timeFilter(p.requested_at)

select value as "mart.duckdb" from obs.run_metrics
where step = 'publish_duckdb' and metric = 'size_bytes' order by recorded_at desc limit 1

panels.title: Événements OpenLineage
panels.description: Runner (scénarios et étapes) + dbt-ol (modèles et tests), envoyés à Marquez.

targets.rawSql:
select coalesce(sum(m.value), 0) as "Émis" from obs.run_metrics m join obs.pipeline_runs p using (run_id)
where m.step = 'lineage' and $__timeFilter(p.requested_at)

panels.title: Derniers runs : statut et volumétrie
panels.description: Une ligne par run, KPIs lus dans obs.run_metrics. Mêmes chiffres que la console Streamlit et l'e-mail récapitulatif.

targets.rawSql:
select p.run_id                                             as "Run",
       p.scenario                                           as "Scénario",
       p.trigger                                            as "Déclencheur",
       p.status                                             as "Statut",
       p.requested_at                                       as "Demandé à",
       round(extract(epoch from p.finished_at - p.started_at)) as "Durée",
       max(m.value) filter (where m.step = 'load_raw' and m.metric = 'rows_read')      as "Lues",
       max(m.value) filter (where m.step = 'load_raw' and m.metric = 'rows_inserted')  as "Insérées",
       max(m.value) filter (where m.step = 'load_raw' and m.metric = 'rows_rejected')  as "Rejetées",
       max(m.value) filter (where m.step = 'load_raw' and m.metric = 'rows_per_s')     as "Lignes/s",
       max(m.value) filter (where m.step = 'quality'  and m.metric = 'quarantine_pct') as "Quarantaine",
       max(m.value) filter (where m.step = 'dbt'      and m.metric = 'tests_warn')     as "Tests avertis",
       max(m.value) filter (where m.step = 'dbt'      and m.metric = 'tests_fail')     as "Tests KO",
       max(m.value) filter (where m.step = 'publish_duckdb' and m.metric = 'size_bytes') as "DuckDB",
       max(m.value) filter (where m.step = 'stress'   and m.metric = 'temp_mb')        as "Temp (Mo)",
       max(m.value) filter (where m.step = 'lineage'  and m.metric = 'events_runner')
         + max(m.value) filter (where m.step = 'lineage' and m.metric = 'events_dbt')  as "OpenLineage",
       p.error                                              as "Erreur"
from obs.pipeline_runs p
left join obs.run_metrics m using (run_id)
where $__timeFilter(p.requested_at)
group by p.run_id
order by p.run_id desc
limit 30

panels.title: Lignes par run (ingestion, échelle log)
panels.description: Lues, insérées et rejetées par load_raw. Échelle logarithmique : 50 rejets restent visibles à côté d'un million de lignes.

targets.rawSql:
select 'run ' || p.run_id || ' · ' || p.scenario as run,
       max(m.value) filter (where m.metric = 'rows_read')     as "lues",
       max(m.value) filter (where m.metric = 'rows_inserted') as "insérées",
       max(m.value) filter (where m.metric = 'rows_rejected') as "rejetées"
from obs.pipeline_runs p
join obs.run_metrics m using (run_id)
where m.step = 'load_raw' and $__timeFilter(p.requested_at)
group by p.run_id, p.scenario
order by p.run_id

select 'run ' || p.run_id || ' · ' || p.scenario as run,
       sum(m.value) filter (where m.step like 'generate%')     as "génération",
       sum(m.value) filter (where m.step = 'load_raw')         as "ingestion",
       sum(m.value) filter (where m.step = 'dbt')              as "dbt",
       sum(m.value) filter (where m.step = 'publish_duckdb')   as "DuckDB",
       sum(m.value) filter (where m.step = 'stress')           as "charge",
       sum(m.value) filter (where m.step = 'reset')            as "reset"
from obs.pipeline_runs p
join obs.run_metrics m using (run_id)
where m.metric = 'step_duration_s' and $__timeFilter(p.requested_at)
group by p.run_id, p.scenario
order by p.run_id

panels.title: Commandes par mois (partitions raw.orders)
panels.description: Estimation PostgreSQL (reltuples), mise à jour par l'autovacuum après chaque chargement.

targets.rawSql:
select replace(partition_name, 'orders_p', '') as mois, estimated_rows as "commandes"
from obs.partition_sizes where table_name = 'orders' order by 1

select table_name as "table", round(sum(size_bytes) / 1e6, 1) as "Mo"
from obs.partition_sizes group by 1 order by 2 desc

select p.finished_at as time, 'quarantaine' as metric, m.value
from obs.run_metrics m join obs.pipeline_runs p using (run_id)
where m.step = 'quality' and m.metric = 'quarantine_pct' and p.finished_at is not null
  and $__timeFilter(p.finished_at)
order by 1

panels.title: Insertions par seconde, par base
panels.description: olist_source : génération (pg13). warehouse : ingestion et dbt (pg16).

panels.title: CPU par conteneur (cœurs)
panels.description: Pic attendu pendant la surcharge : pg13 (génération), pg16 (ingestion, requête lourde), runner.

targets.expr: sum by (name) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="cadvisor", cpu="total", id=~"/docker/.+"}[1m]) * on (id) group_left (name) label_replace(max by (container_id, name) (up{job="docker-names"}) * 0 + 1, "id", "/docker/$1", "container_id", "(.+)"))

sum by (name) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="cadvisor", id=~"/docker/.+"} * on (id) group_left (name) label_replace(max by (container_id, name) (up{job="docker-names"}) * 0 + 1, "id", "/docker/$1", "container_id", "(.+)"))

panels.title: Fichiers temporaires PostgreSQL
panels.description: Requêtes qui dépassent work_mem et débordent sur disque.

panels.title: Crons (APScheduler dans le runner, définis dans obs.schedules)
Crons définis
panels.description: Créés depuis la console Streamlit. Le runner les relit toutes les 30 s.

targets.rawSql:
select s.schedule_id as "Cron", s.cron as "Expression", s.scenario as "Scénario", s.enabled as "Actif",
       count(p.run_id) as "Runs",
       count(p.run_id) filter (where p.status = 'failed') as "Échecs",
       max(p.finished_at) filter (where p.status = 'success') as "Dernier succès",
       (array_agg(p.status order by p.run_id desc))[1] as "Dernier statut"
from obs.schedules s left join obs.pipeline_runs p on p.schedule_id = s.schedule_id
group by s.schedule_id order by s.schedule_id

panels.title: Depuis le dernier succès (rouge : plus de 2 intervalles)
panels.description: En nombre d'intervalles prévus. Au-delà de 2 : alerte « Cron en retard ».

panels.title: Exécutions par statut
panels.description: success, failed, missed (déclenchement manqué : runner arrêté) ou error.

panels.title: Alertes reçues par le runner (webhook → obs.alerts)

targets.rawSql:
select received_at as "Reçue à", alertname as "Alerte", severity as "Sévérité", status as "État",
       payload -> 'annotations' ->> 'summary' as "Résumé"
from obs.alerts where $__timeFilter(received_at) order by alert_id desc limit 50

options.content:
Chaque run émet un job **`olist/scenario.<nom>`** et un job enfant par étape :
`generate_*`, `load_raw`, `publish_duckdb`, `stress`, `reset`.
dbt-ol s'y rattache (**`dbt-run-olist`**) avec ses modèles et ses tests.

Les datasets portent les mêmes noms partout : le graphe va de la source PostgreSQL 13
jusqu'au fichier DuckDB, avec le nombre de lignes écrites par étape.

- [Marquez](http://localhost:3000) : graphe et historique des runs
- [Streamlit](http://localhost:8501) : lancer un scénario, suivre la console
- [Mailpit](http://localhost:8025) : récapitulatifs et alertes par e-mail
